description: A literal link destination or image source with a scheme §5.2 does not admit (`javascript:`, `data:image/svg+xml`) in a static `<md>` body is E-MD-URL-SCHEME.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F2 "yes a." (same closed element/attribute set, same §5.2 URL guard)
rationale: §67.6: a literal destination with an unadmitted scheme in a static body (`[x](javascript:…)`, `![x](data:image/svg+xml,…)`) is E-MD-URL-SCHEME.
